App.Name: Toolkit License
Nav.Label: Admin menu
Confirm.Title: Confirm
Error.Title: Something went wrong
Error.Text: The request could not be handled. Try again in a few minutes; if it keeps failing, check the server log.
Setup.Title: Create the admin account
Setup.Intro: No admin account exists yet. Enter the setup code from this file on the server (the file is deleted once the account is created):
Setup.Error.Code: The setup code is not correct.
Account.PasswordRule: At least 10 characters with upper case, lower case and a digit.
Account.RecoveryLeft: {0} recovery codes left. Each code works once when the authenticator app is not at hand.
Account.NewCodesConfirm: Make 10 new recovery codes? The old codes stop working.
Login.Title: Admin sign-in
Login.Error.Locked: The account is locked for 15 minutes after too many failed tries.
Login.Error.Code: The code is wrong or has expired.
Login.CodeIntro: Open the authenticator app on your phone and enter the 6-digit Toolkit License code.
Login.RecoveryIntro: Enter one of the recovery codes saved when two-factor sign-in was set up. Each works once.
Login.UseRecovery: No phone? Use a recovery code
Login.UseApp: Use a code from the authenticator app
TwoFactor.Title: Set up two-factor sign-in
TwoFactor.Intro: The admin app requires two-factor sign-in. Do these three steps to continue.
TwoFactor.Step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone (Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator, 2FAS…).
TwoFactor.Step2: In the app, add an account by entering a key, then type this key (case and spaces do not matter):
TwoFactor.Step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
TwoFactor.Error.Code: The code is not right. Check the key you entered and the phone's clock.
Recovery.Title: Recovery codes
Recovery.Warning: Keep these 10 codes somewhere safe (a password manager, paper in a drawer). They are shown once and are the only way in if the phone is lost.
Identity.PasswordTooShort: The password needs at least 10 characters.
Identity.PasswordRequiresLower: The password needs a lower-case letter.
Identity.PasswordRequiresUpper: The password needs an upper-case letter.
Identity.PasswordRequiresUniqueChars: The password needs more different characters.
Identity.PasswordMismatch: The current password is not right.
Identity.InvalidUserName: Use only letters, digits and . _ - @ in the username.
Activation.NoPending: No requests are waiting. Requests from the Toolkit desktop app show up here.
Activation.ManualIntro: Device cannot reach the server? Paste the activation code (starting with TKT1.) the user sent by chat or mail. After approving, copy the license and send it back.
Activation.NewCustomerHint: A name here links the device to this new user.
Activation.ApproveConfirm: Issue a license to the device "{0}"?
Activation.RejectConfirm: Reject the request from the device "{0}"?
Activation.AlreadyLicensed: This device already has a valid license; it is shown below.
Token.Error.Malformed: The code cannot be read. Paste all of it, starting with TKT1.
Token.Error.BadSignature: The code's signature does not match: it was changed or cut short.
Token.Error.BadDevice: The device id in the code is not valid.
Token.Error.KeyMismatch: This device id is registered with another key (the data folder may have been copied to another computer).
Token.Error.Stale: The device clock is too far off.
License.Title: License
License.OnlineHint: The desktop app picks this license up on its next check.
License.ManualHint: Copy the license and send it to the user to paste into the app.
License.Term.Hint: The license runs until the end of the chosen day. It can be revoked at any time.
License.Error.KeepExpired: The current license has ended or does not exist; pick a new term.
Device.Title: Device
Device.Empty: No devices yet. A device appears when it asks for activation.
Device.AssignHint: Licenses issued from now on carry this user's name.
Device.ReissueIntro: Issue a new license in place of the current one (lost file, renewal, new term, or after a revoke). The app picks it up on its next check.
Device.ReissueConfirm: Issue a new license to "{0}"? The current one, if any, is replaced.
Device.RevokeIntro: The device loses access on its next check. Its data stays on the computer.
Device.RevokeConfirm: Revoke the license of the device "{0}"?
Device.NoLicense: No license issued to this device.
Device.Error.NoActiveLicense: The device has no active license.
Customer.Label: User
Customer.Empty: No users yet. Add one here or while approving a request.
Customer.Name: Name
Customer.NoDevices: No device is linked to this user.
Customer.DeleteConfirm: Delete the user "{0}"? Their {1} devices keep their licenses but are no longer linked to anyone.
Customer.Error.Name: Enter a name.
Customer.Error.Email: That email does not look right.
Release.VersionHint: Like 1.2.0, the same as <Version> in Toolkit's csproj.
Release.DownloadHint: Optional. The installer comes in stage M5.
Release.MandatoryLabel: Required update (devices on an older version are asked to update before going on)
Release.DeleteConfirm: Delete release {0}? Devices are compared with the latest remaining release.
Release.Error.Url: The download address must start with https:// or http://.
Key.BackupWarning: Back up {0} somewhere safe. Without it no license the app trusts can be issued; anyone who gets it can make licenses.
Key.Intro: The Toolkit desktop app checks licenses with this public key (stage M4). The public key is not a secret.
